main_analysis: Revised measurements and agreed primary specification; no known coding errors as alternatives.
common_requirements: Specify reference and alternative before examining effect estimates.
Record sample IDs or hashes, folds, exposure, outcome, features, settings and runtime.
Report changed membership and changed target effects explicitly.
No significance-based choice of specifications or robustness pass/fail.
Current complete-input component produces no inferential research results.

analyses.title: Adjustment-set sensitivity
analyses.threat: Dependence on uncertain covariate timing and adjustment choices
analyses.variation: Refit primary and without_psyprob; add METHUSE only within a prespecified reporting-support population; PRIMPAY only with explicitly prepared common inputs
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Assess for each DV; document not-applicable cases with evidence rather than mechanically forcing a test.

detcrim_reporting_state_comparison.design: Define reporting states using applicable training observations; compare addition of DETCRIM on the same reporting-state episodes and folds. Do not compare a restricted-state estimate directly with the broader primary estimate as an isolated feature effect.
detcrim_reporting_state_comparison.limitation: Observed reporting does not establish ignorable missingness; assess remaining applicable missing values.

analyses.tree_result_assessment: Refit the causal forest and policy tree under defensible adjustment alternatives. Compare splits, subgroup membership, subgroup estimates and policy assignments; retain same-episode comparisons where possible.

complete_case_point_comparisons.population: Common category-supported complete-case evaluation episodes; exclusions disclosed

analyses.title: Covariate-missingness sensitivity
analyses.threat: Dependence on missing-data models and selection into complete cases
analyses.variation: Categorical-regression MI versus CART MI and explicitly defined complete-case analysis
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Assess for each DV; document not-applicable cases with evidence rather than mechanically forcing a test.
analyses.tree_result_assessment: Compare tree results under validated categorical MI, CART MI and complete cases. Disclose population changes and summarize variation across imputations; never concatenate draws as independent episodes.

analyses.title: Limited-overlap and weight sensitivity
analyses.threat: Dependence on extreme weights or unsupported extrapolation
analyses.variation: Explicit weight-handling rules and separately labeled supported-population contrasts
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Assess for each DV; document not-applicable cases with evidence rather than mechanically forcing a test.
analyses.tree_result_assessment: Evaluate tree results under defensible support/weight rules supported by the estimator. Report changed populations, node sample sizes and treatment support; do not mechanically transfer AIPW clipping to a forest.

analyses.title: Missing-discharge-outcome sensitivity
analyses.variation: Explicit departures from reference outcome-observation assumptions by exposure group
pending: Target population and estimator; descriptive bounds are not causal-effect bounds
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Required for frequency missingness; assess completion ascertainment and REASON eligibility selection separately. Observed completion by construction does not eliminate selection.
analyses.tree_result_assessment: For frequency, assess how outcome-observation assumptions affect subgroup estimates and policy conclusions. Refit trees only when the scenario defines compatible estimation inputs; assess completion ascertainment/selection separately.

analyses.title: Unmeasured-confounding sensitivity
analyses.threat: Bias from omitted common causes of LOS and outcome
analyses.variation: Estimator-compatible sensitivity parameters calibrated against observed covariates where possible
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Assess for each DV; document not-applicable cases with evidence rather than mechanically forcing a test.
analyses.tree_result_assessment: Assess vulnerability of both result sets and prespecified or independently evaluated subgroups using a compatible method. Fixed-group sensitivity bounds do not certify the entire selected tree or require a new tree for every parameter.

analyses.title: Estimation-method sensitivity
analyses.threat: Dependence on estimation and nuisance-model specifications
analyses.variation: Alternative estimator for the same effect and prespecified nuisance-model alternatives
analyses.fixed: Exposure, outcome, episode IDs and folds where feasible; disclose any changes
analyses.target_change: Explicitly report if population or estimand differs
analyses.applicability_rule: Assess for each DV; document not-applicable cases with evidence rather than mechanically forcing a test.
analyses.tree_result_assessment: Compare compatible heterogeneous-effect learners and resulting tree summaries when available; retain AIPW/IPW/standardization average estimates as supporting benchmarks rather than claiming they independently produce comparable trees.

analyses.title: Sample-size and subsampling stability
analyses.reference: Full frozen development population; same comparison records
analyses.variation: Nested stratified development subsamples with repeated sampling seeds

required_designs.negative: same or more use than admission
required_designs.operationalization: Use same-substance matching within the baseline-user population.
required_designs.baseline_nonusers: Separate sustained-abstinence analysis for baseline nonusers.

components: Outcome-observation selection assessment for each DV
endogeneity_assessment.limitations: No omnibus test proves absence of endogeneity. Realized LOS/outcome joint determination remains; no unsupported IV or reverse-causality test.
endogeneity_assessment.tree_scope: Both outcome result sets; subgroup-specific diagnostics where estimable. No significance-based model selection or claim that tests establish exogeneity.

development_results.scope: real training complete-case point estimates only

phase_deliverables.source: Historical duration design: two sets of trees using the same 30-day treatment definition, with completion and frequency outcomes and sensitivity analyses for both.
phase_deliverables.decision_rule: Do not mark a family finalized solely because average-effect comparisons ran.
